info.title: API.SH: Welcome to the Jungle
info.description: The Welcome to the Jungle API from API.SH: public Welcome to the Jungle data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Welcome to the Jungle career articles
get.description:
The site's career and workplace articles in one language, by keyword or author: title, link, summary, SEO title and description, image, authors, categories, companies featured and publish date. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wttj-articles

get.summary: Welcome to the Jungle company search
get.description:
Companies with a profile on Welcome to the Jungle, by keyword, country, city, sector, size and label. Each company: `name`, `slug`, `url`, `open_jobs`, `employees`, `size`, `sectors`, `description`, `labels`, `locations`, `tools`, `logo`, `published_at` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wttj-companies

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes of an office.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Comma-separated sector names in English, e.g. `Software`, `SaaS / Cloud Services`.

parameters.name: sector_group
parameters.description: Comma-separated sector groups in English, e.g. `Tech`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Welcome to the Jungle company jobs
get.description:
A company's open jobs, with every filter of `/wttj/v1/search`. Each job: `id`, `reference`, `slug`, `title`, `url`, `company` (name, slug, logo, employees, founded, labels), `contract_type`, contract duration, `remote`, salary (min, max, currency, period, yearly minimum), `experience_min_years`, `education_level`, `language`, `locations`, `geo`, `sectors`, `profession`, `benefits`, `summary`, `key_missions`, `profile`, `published_at` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Unknown companies answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wttj-company-jobs

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Company slug or its company page link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes of the office, e.g. `FR`, `US,GB`.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Comma-separated office cities as the site writes them, e.g. `Paris`, `London`.

parameters.name: salary_min
parameters.description: Minimum yearly salary shown on the ad (in its currency), e.g. `45000`.

parameters.name: salary_shown
parameters.description: `true`: only ads that show a salary.

parameters.name: experience_min
parameters.description: Minimum years of experience asked, at least this many.

parameters.name: experience_max
parameters.description: Minimum years of experience asked, at most this many (e.g. `0` for no experience required).

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Comma-separated sector references from results (`sectors[].reference`), e.g. `software-1`, `finance-2`.

parameters.name: ad_language
parameters.description: Comma-separated language codes the ad is written in, e.g. `en`, `fr`.

parameters.name: benefit
parameters.description: Comma-separated benefits as listed in results (`benefits`), e.g. `Parking`.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: `true`: add counts per value for the main filters (`facets`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Jobs per page, 1-100 (default 30). The site serves the first 1,000 matches of a query.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Welcome to the Jungle job ad
get.description:
One job ad: full description, profile wanted and hiring process (text and HTML), company (description, website, logo, employees, labels), contract type and duration, start date, remote policy, salary range, experience and education level, profession, office address with coordinates, tools, benefits by category, application form fields, videos, publish and update dates. `latest=true` with search parameters returns the first matching ad. Removed ads answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wttj-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job link (welcometothejungle.com/en/companies/<company>/jobs/<job>), `<company-slug>/<job-slug>`, or `id` from search.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first ad of a search with the search parameters (`q`, `country`, `contract_type`, ...) instead of `id`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Welcome to the Jungle job search
get.description:
Jobs on Welcome to the Jungle (France, Europe, US) for a keyword, with every filter of the site's job index: contract type, remote policy, country, city, region, salary, experience, education, posting age, sector, profession, ad language, benefits, company, company labels and a radius around a point. Each job: `id`, `reference`, `slug`, `title`, `url`, `company` (name, slug, logo, employees, founded, labels), `contract_type`, contract duration, `remote`, salary (min, max, currency, period, yearly minimum), `experience_min_years`, `education_level`, `language`, `locations`, `geo`, `sectors`, `profession`, `benefits`, `summary`, `key_missions`, `profile`, `published_at` and `raw`. `total` is the site's count; `facets=true` adds counts per filter value. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/wttj-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
